common.navigateHint: Use <0/> and <1/> to move through the list.

commandPalette.title: Command menu
commandPalette.description: Search for a page or action and press Enter to run it.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work everywhere except in text fields.

inbox.emptyDescription: Messages appear here once a mail account is connected.

tasks.emptyDescription: Tasks found in your messages are listed here.

digest.emptyDescription: A daily summary of new messages is created after the first sync.

search.emptyDescription: Search covers all synced messages and attachments.

settings.more: Mail accounts, language models and notifications will be configured here.
settings.serverDescription: Status of the connection to the ollamail server.

admin.auditDescription: Sign-ins, role changes, key rotation and other security events.
admin.more: Users, sign-in methods and mail providers will be managed here once these areas are available.
admin.aiDescription: Providers, model per task, hardware profile and cloud access.
admin.retentionDescription: How long mails, attachments, search index, question history, digests and audit log are kept.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.emptyDescription: Security events such as sign-ins and role changes are recorded here.

taskDescriptions.rag_chat: Answers questions with sources from the mail.

cloud.label: Allow cloud LLMs
cloud.description: Allows providers marked as cloud. Default: off.
cloud.warningTitle: Data is sent to third parties
cloud.warning: While cloud LLMs are allowed, ollamail sends mail content (text, subject, sender, attachment text) to the cloud provider of every task assigned to one. Check the data processing agreement, server location and retention first. All users see a permanent notice.

providers.environmentHint: From the environment (OLLAMAIL_LLM_*), cannot be changed here.
providers.deleteDescription: The provider and its API key are removed.
providers.inUse: The provider is still assigned to tasks. Assign them to another provider first.

test.unreachable: Not reachable. Check the URL, the network and whether the service is running.
test.unauthorized: Access denied (HTTP {{status}}). Check the API key.
test.rejected: Request rejected (HTTP {{status}}). Check URL and type.
test.failed: Unexpected response. Check URL and type.

form.description: An endpoint that serves language models, e.g. Ollama, vLLM or an OpenAI-compatible service.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _. Cannot be changed.
form.nameInvalid: Only lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (max. 32 characters).
form.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an http(s) URL without credentials.
form.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.apiKeyKeep: Set. Leave empty to keep it.
form.isCloudHint: Mail content leaves the instance. Only usable while cloud LLMs are allowed.

assignments.modelRequired: Enter a model for the chosen provider.
assignments.blocked: Cloud provider, but cloud LLMs are blocked: this task does not run.
assignments.hint: Changes apply from the next job on, without a restart.

performance.profileDescription: Default models and context size. Applies to tasks without a model of their own.
performance.concurrencyDescription: Concurrent language model requests per worker (1–{{max}}). 1 on CPU hosts.

retention.title: Retention
retention.hint: 0 keeps the data. Deleted data cannot be restored.
retention.shortMailWarning: Shorter than the initial import of new mailboxes ({{days}} days): a full resync imports older mails, which are deleted again the next night.
retention.neverRun: Not run yet. Data older than the retention periods is deleted every night, including files.
retention.lastRun: Last run {{date}}: {{mails}} mails, {{attachments}} attachments, {{chunks}} search index entries and {{events}} audit log entries deleted.

mail_days.label: Mails
mail_days.description: With attachments, search index and triage results, by date received.

attachment_days.label: Attachments
attachment_days.description: Only the attachment files; the mail stays.

search_index_days.label: Search index
search_index_days.description: Older mails are no longer found by search and questions.

digest_days.label: Digests
digest_days.description: Summaries with audio files. At least one day.

audit_days.label: Audit log
audit_days.description: Security events. The hash chain stays verifiable from the oldest remaining entry.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address does not exist or is no longer available.

errors.network: The server is not reachable. Check your connection.
errors.badRequest: The request could not be processed.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.conflict: The item was changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.server: A server error occurred. Please try again later.

auth.passwordTooShort_one: The password must have at least {{count}} character.
auth.passwordTooShort_other: The password must have at least {{count}} characters.

login.title: Sign in to ollamail
login.invalidCredentials: E-mail address or password is incorrect.
login.throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.noMethods: No sign-in method is configured. Contact your administrator.

setup.title: Set up ollamail
setup.description: Create the first account. It gets administrator rights and can add further users and sign-in methods.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, unless the server requires a different length.
setup.tokenHint: Shown in the server log at start-up (setup_code) or set via OLLAMAIL_SETUP_TOKEN.
setup.alreadyInitialized: This instance has already been set up. Sign in instead.
setup.providersDescription: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, Google, GitHub or LDAP so that others can sign in with their existing account. You can do this later in the admin area.

account.title: Account
account.timeZoneDescription: Used for dates, digests and reminders.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.description: This page is only available to administrators.

export.title: Export data
export.description: ZIP with your profile, categories, corrections, tasks, digests including audio, and question history. The download link is valid for {{hours}} hours.
export.failed: Export failed. Please request it again.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Deletes your account with all mailboxes, mails, tasks, digests and question history. This cannot be undone.
delete.disabled: Accounts are deleted by an administrator. Contact them if you want your account removed.
delete.confirmDescription: All mailboxes, mails, attachments, tasks, digests, question history and exports are deleted immediately. The mails remain in your mail accounts. Export your data first if you want to keep it.
delete.confirmLabel: To confirm, enter your e-mail address {{email}}
delete.lastAdmin: You are the last administrator. Make another user an administrator first.
